description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different r, Gazeta” illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with the parameter shown on the x-axis for four finetuning method/model combinations. The x-axis is labeled “log r,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 9 with ticks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 36 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23.3 at log r = 0, increases slightly to about 24.4 by log r = 6–7, and ends around 24.2 at log r = 9 with only small fluctuations throughout; the purple line (MBart + LoRA) starts near 4.8 at log r = 0, rises to about 8.0 at log r = 1, drops to about 2.6 at log r = 2, then increases sharply to about 18.9 at log r = 4 and continues upward to about 24.0 at log r = 8 before ending near 23.3 at log r = 9; the green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) starts around 23.3 at log r = 0, increases gradually to about 26.0 at log r = 3, then rises to about 29.0 at log r = 5 and ends near 30.1 at log r = 9; the orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 4.8 at log r = 0, increases steadily to about 19.4 at log r = 3, jumps to about 32.0 at log r = 4, then increases slightly and levels off around 33.3–33.5 from log r = 6 through log r = 9.
